title: LangGraph — explicit state machines
intro: Five steps, one typed State, and control flow you can point at.

steps.title: It's just Python functions
steps.body: The lab's own point: **LangGraph is all about Python functions — it doesn't need LLMs.** Nodes are plain functions over a shared **State**; agents are just nodes that happen to call a model.

steps.title: State and reducers
steps.body: State is a TypedDict or Pydantic model. The subtlety is **`Annotated`**: each field can name a **reducer** — the function LangGraph calls to merge a node's update into existing state (`add_messages` for the common chat case). Reducers make concurrent updates principled instead of last-write-wins.

steps.title: The five steps
steps.body: 1. Define the **State** (with reducers) → 2. start the **Graph Builder** → 3. add **nodes** (functions) → 4. add **edges** (conditional edges = your branches) → 5. **compile**, then invoke.

points.label: Explicitness
points.note: Branches, retries, escalations live in named edges — not buried in a prompt.

points.label: Checkpoints
points.note: SQLite checkpointer (the labs' memory.db): resume, replay, time-travel. The graph remembers where it was.

points.label: Determinism
points.note: The same property folio's blueprints assert: a flow that must never skip a step should be drawn, not implied.

steps.title: Sidekick
steps.body:
The week's project: a personal co-worker — an LLM node with tools (including **Playwright browser automation**), a **success-evaluator node**, and conditional edges looping until the evaluator passes the user's criteria. The week-1 judge pattern, rebuilt as an explicit, checkpointed graph.

> [!tip] Choose by control-flow certainty: handoffs delegate a conversation, crews delegate to roles, **graphs delegate nothing** — they route state through functions you named.

recap:
**State first, reducers before nodes, loops in edges.**

- Nodes = plain functions; agents are nodes that call LLMs.
- Annotated reducers define how updates merge.
- Checkpointing (memory.db) buys resume/replay.
- Draw the flow when it must never silently skip a step.
